confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels, calibrated to the supplied Vienna, Athens and Tbilisi figures; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Food, cafe and beer anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July rates vary widely by season and neighbourhood. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the beer anchor using typical local ratios (about 2.3x and 1.3x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value was taken from search-result content for the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Vienna is the closest comparable for hotels, hostels and mid-range dining; Berlin food, cafe and beer levels are set somewhat below Vienna's, while hostel and hotel anchors sit near Vienna's level with hostel beds slightly higher for July demand. Athens anchors the inexpensive-meal level and Tbilisi serves as a low-cost reference point.
